name: Runner Extras - non-image Media content
brief: Pins that a Media field accepts content that is not an image, and refuses image content by name.
description: A Media field is not an image field. BC decides what it holds by trying to decode it as an image and falling back to application/octet-stream when that fails, which is how a report layout, a PDF or any other blob gets stored at all. The runner has no System.Drawing on this platform, so that decode failed with a different exception type than BC's fallback filter expects and EVERY media write failed — including writes that were never images. These tests pin the non-image path as working and the image path as refused by name rather than silently wrong.
